description: This is a Java source file defining a base activity class for Android applications. It manages logging setup and provides a common superclass for other activities.

classes.name: SampleActivityBase
classes.description: A base activity class that extends FragmentActivity, mainly to initialize logging.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, calling superclass implementation.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Overrides the lifecycle method, calls super and initializes logging.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up logging by creating a LogWrapper and attaching it to the Log chain; logs an 'Ready' message.
